CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW FRANCONNECT_REPORTING.GYM_ATTRIBUTES(
  FRANCHISEENAME,
  FRANCHISEID,
  STORESTATUS,
  GRANDSTOREOPENINGDATE,
  SAME_GYM,
  STATE
) AS
SELECT
  f.franchiseename,
  TRY_TO_DOUBLE(f.franchiseename) AS franchiseid,
  f.storestatus,
  f.grandstoreopeningdate,

FROM FRANCONNECT_REPORTING.franchisee f
